title: Dhātupāṭha: three semantic assignments

rights_basis: Pinned upstream source-scope manifest records permission to reuse with appropriate attribution; only three classical Sanskrit entries and relevant metadata retained.

manifest_state.limitation: Derived reading, not independent of its base. Library-wide collation has352 differences,277 open; no page witness used. These three selected root/meaning pairs match raw and primary exactly.

scope: Only the distinction among knowing, seeing and hearing semantic assignments. No full derivation of Veda, darśana or śruti; no claim that roots have only one sense across all Sanskrit use. No interpreter, parser or generated form table used.
independent_review_status: Selected three source entries, simple root labels, meaning distinctions and gaṇa/pada metadata independently reviewed; no noun derivation certified.
